notes.title: Bundles of Tokyo Chronos, Last Labyrinth, ALTDEUS, and The Tale of Onogoro
notes.content:
The Tale of Onogoro and Last Labyrinth, developed by Amata, and the bundle of Tokyo Chronos and ALTDEUS: Beyond Chronos, developed by MyDearest, are available today! 

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/28374/VR

Amata and MyDearest are coming together to collaborate on Steam! These leading Japanese VR game development companies have worked together to deliver the “VR Adventure Bundle” containing four VR adventure game titles (two from each company) on Steam, going on sale today at a special 20% off the price. 
The four titles of Last Labyrinth and The Tale of Onogoro from Amata and TOKYO CHRONOS and ALTDEUS: Beyond Chronos from MyDearest are available to buy at a lower price than if bought individually. For those who have already bought some of the relevant titles, you can still find the others for a special price, so please check them out and enjoy the four titles together.
These four titles are also part of the Steam Autumn Sale 2022, which begins today, so the bundle versions will be available at an even better price during this sale. Don’t miss this great chance!

◆Overview of Bundled Editions

 Product name: VR Adventure Bundle
 Bundle contents: "Tokyo Chronos", "Last Labyrinth", "ALTDEUS: Beyond Chronos", "The Tale of Onogoro".
 Price: 124.96 USD →99.97 USD (20% off)
 During the Steam Autumn Sale 2022 (until November 29th, 2022, at 10 am PT), additional discounts will be applied to each title.


About TOKYO CHRONOS
An empty, deserted Shibuya where time has frozen over. A suspenseful mystery woven by 8 childhood friends trapped inside.
The future of visual novels, storytelling in VR.
This game will put the player directly in the world of the story.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1031440/TOKYO_CHRONOS/

About Last Labyrinth
An escape-the-room adventure game that can only be experienced in VR, Last Labyrinth was
created specifically for the VR age. Players must work to escape a mansion full of hidden
dangers with a mysterious girl that appears before them.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/979400/Last_Labyrinth/

About ALTDEUS: Beyond Chronos
ALTDEUS features 15-20 hours of gameplay with one of the largest branching storylines ever in a VR game. Become Chloe, a mecha pilot who will have her revenge and annihilate the Meteora once and for all. Pilot a giant mecha and make the decisions to determine humanity’s future.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1502080/ALTDEUS_Beyond_Chronos/

About The Tale of Onogoro
The Tale of Onogoro was created by producer/director Hiromichi Takahashi and the development team behind the VR Escape-the-Room game Last Labyrinth. Last Labyrinth received numerous accolades at game and VR events worldwide due to its unique VR experience. 
The Tale of Onogoro combines traditional Japanese culture and steampunk elements to create its unique world. The Player travels with Haru, a Japanese high priestess, solving sprawling puzzles and battling giant beast-like beings called “Kami” along the way.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2023880/_The_Tale_of_Onogoro/

notes.title: Notice: Change in Method of Model Recognition for VR Devices
notes.content:
We are pleased to announce that we have updated the application on Steam Store today, adding the following functions and fixing the following bugs.


 Target distribution store: Steam
 Update date: October 26, 2022
 Version:  1.1.0152
 How to update: Please follow the instructions on the app's dashboard.

[Main updates/fixes]
[olist]
 We have changed how we recognize VR devices to improve compatibility between various HMDs and controllers.
This allows you to play with HMD and controller combinations from different manufacturers that are compatible with SteamVR.
When an unsupported controller is used in the "The Tale of Onogoro" application, a dialog box will be displayed with setting instructions so it can be manually adapted.
 Other minor adjustments.
[/olist]

We apologize for any inconvenience that these bugs may have caused you.
We hope you continue to enjoy The Tale of Onogoro.

notes.title: The Tale of Onogoro + RUINSMAGUS Bundle Edition Now Available!
notes.content:
The Tale of Onogoro and RUINSMAGUS bundle, a Japanese anime-style VR action-adventure game, is now available on Steam.
Developed by CharacterBank Inc., RUINSMAGUS puts players in the role of a Magus armed with a magical gauntlet as you explore the mysterious Ruins beneath the city. Joining you on your adventure is your companion Iris, a novice researcher, as you uncover the dark secrets and prevent a terrifying future in this narrative action adventure.
The Tale of Onogoro and RUINSMAGUS is perfect for fans of Japanese anime, and we wanted to recommend them together, which is why we have created this bundle edition.
Each is available at a discount price compared to purchasing them individually.
Those who have already purchased The Tale of Onogoro or RUINSMAGUS will also receive a discount and can enjoy the other title as well.

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/28375/VR/

Dive in and experience the magical world of Grand Amnis!
Armed with the gauntlet, explore the mysterious Ruins beneath the city with your companion Iris, a novice researcher, as you uncover the dark secrets and prevent a terrifying future in this narrative action adventure.

notes.title: The Tale of Onogoro is available today! & Launch Sale!
notes.content:
The SteamVR version of The Tale of Onogoro has finally been released today.

To celebrate the launch of the SteamVR version, a 20% off sale will be held starting today.
In conjunction with this release, The Tale of Onogoro Original Soundtrack is now also available for purchase on the Steam Store.

The SteamVR version of the game features graphic options such as high-resolution rendering, soft-shadow effect enhancements, as well as extra post-processing effects, all of which are aimed at providing gamers with higher-quality experiences according to their PC specifications. 

*Please refer to the Official website "How to Play" page for more details, along with instructions on how to operate the game with a SteamVR-compatible VR headset.

notes.title: The 6th International VR Awards Public Voting Now Open!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42780998/b48be0bc2645914c8b19a0fb36ac2df0aad8ede0.png

The Tale of Onogoro was chosen as a finalist in the VR Game of the Year division at the 6th International VR Awards held by the AIXR (Academy of International Extended Reality).

Public voting has started, so please cast your vote for The Tale of Onogoro.

Click here to vote

 Voting ends on Friday, September 30, 2022.
 You must be logged in to Facebook, Google, or Linkedin to vote.
 You can vote for up to 3 titles in the VR Game of the Year.


The VR Awards are international awards that recognize and honor outstanding achievements in VR, and are a must-see for professionals in any industry involving immersive technology. In 2022, the award ceremony will be held in Rotterdam, the Netherlands, on December 1.
